core_problem_solved: To provide a comprehensive, open-source reporting engine for Java, enabling the generation of pixel-perfect, data-driven documents from virtually any data source and exporting them to a wide variety of formats.
key_features: Connectivity to multiple data sources (JDBC, XML, CSV, Java Beans, etc.)
XML-based report templates (JRXML) that can be designed visually (e.g., with Jaspersoft Studio)
A rich set of report elements including charts, images, subreports, and tables
Exporting capabilities to numerous formats like PDF, HTML, XLS, CSV, and DOCX
era_and_niche: A dominant force in Java-based business intelligence and enterprise reporting for many years. It is the go-to solution for generating complex, multi-page documents like invoices, financial statements, and detailed operational reports.
reason_for_obsolescence: This library is **not obsolete** but its problem domain has become more specialized. While it remains a leader for complex, print-oriented document generation, many simpler reporting tasks in modern web applications are now handled by client-side JavaScript libraries that visualize data from APIs. Its main competitor is the Eclipse BIRT project.
